title: Wonderful Family Experience
text: Our tour guide, Anna, was wonderful!  We had an amazing afternoon and she kept our three children (aged 8, 10 and 13) engaged and happy the whole time.  We felt so lucky to see so many special and hidden things in Barcelona that we wouldn’t have otherwise seen!
author: Jamielynne_A

title: Amazing guide for an amazing city
text:
Philippe made our trip. He is such a knowledgeable guide, giving not only my wife and I but our 9 & 13 y/o sons lots of fascinating facts about Barcelona's history as well as the Catalan culture. 

My 13 y/o son had Fideuà as per his suggestion and loved it. My 9 year old can't stop telling people the difference between Japanese & Chinese dragons - 3 or 5?!? We all enjoyed a cup of the best hot chocolate ever at Museu de la Xocolata too.

Overall, Philippe kept us all thoroughly engaged throughout the whole tour. If you want to experience the best parts of Barcelona, get in touch with him 👍
author: Spongebob69Leeds

title: Great City and Monserrat Tour
text: Marcel overall was a great tour guide for our family.  Our Barcelona city tour overlapped with our Gothic tour in terms of places and Marcel was able to pivot and show us other things that we had not seen.  He was engaging with her 7-year-old providing fun games and challenges for her along the way and some surprises which made it easy to keep her attention for the walking to her.  We took a second trip and tour with him the following day to Montserrat monastery. title: Patient and kind, knowledgeable. Worth it!
text: Amazing guide. We had a wonderful experience with Federico. We couldn’t have toured the city without him. Very kind and patient with our large group and small children!
author: D4062KAstevenk

title: Super cool and kids friendly experience
text: Sebastian is a great host! He gave us a very warm welcome and showed us places we would have never found otherwise. Cool stories and funny fact for the kids. All the food and treats made this experience fantastic.
author: basvis

title: Perfect tour for family
text:
Fiorella did a phenomenal job of keeping our kids (8 and 6) engaged with the history of Barcelona while also doing the same with the adults. If you have kids and want to know about what you are looking at while visiting the oldest parts of Barcelona, this tour with Fiorella is the best.

We also enjoyed hearing what it was like to live in some of the neighborhoods from someone who actually lived there!
author: RobynH771

title: Fantastic overview of Barcelona
text: Sebastian was amazing great overview of Barcelona and enjoyable for the kids even though it was hot. Learnt a lot and engaged the kids. Highly recommended
author: David_C

title: Great City guide experience
text:
We were lucky to have Marcel as a guide. He was well prepared and knew a lot to tell about Barcelona, which we did not know already in an interesting way. The kids liked his explanations as well and time flew quickly. We got to know the “real Barca” through him and had a great time. 
We highly recommend Marcel as a guide for everyone who wants to see Barcelona not only from a tourist view. It feels like having a friend here..👍🏻
author: corinneb608

title: Unique experience
text: I loved the tiger area and the farm, plus the.zipline. In itself, everything they offer is very fun and very nice to live it.
author: cinthiamM6455YJ

title: Gothic quarter with kids
text: Fiorella was wonderful! Kept my 3 year old engaged and knew what would win her heart, treats! She made the tour great for adults wanting to learn and explore the old city with kids. She is very knowledgeable and would highly recommend her for a tour again!!!
